animations.name: idle
animations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Dune tactical game Fremen Scout IDLE animation sprite strip.
Input image is the canonical character design reference, NOT a new design request. Match the FIRST character in the input exactly: sand-brown pointed hood, dark wrapped face, tan sleeves and tunic over dark undersuit, trailing worn brown cloak to left, olive-brown belt pouch, dark gloves and boots, knee pads, same long dark rifle with tan wrapped fore-end pointing right. Match existing illustrated painted shading, thin dark contour, muted palette, side-on slightly elevated camera. Do not redesign the weapon or costume.
Generate ONLY idle: exactly FOUR distinct ordered full-body frames in ONE horizontal row on genuine transparent RGBA background. Natural subtle breathing cycle at 6 fps, quiet ready stance with rifle pointing east/right throughout; slight shoulder rise and cloth motion, no walking or firing. Same anatomy, scale, head size, rifle length, torso pivot in all frames. Last pose transitions naturally to first without duplicate end frame.
Desired export 1600 x 336 pixels, four equal 400 x 336 cells. Standing figure about 280 pixels high, planted feet y=312, body ground anchor x=200 in each cell. Entire figure and long rifle fit WITH clear transparent margin inside each cell; no adjacent figure overlap or clipping. If exact size unsupported, preserve this aspect ratio and evenly spaced four-cell layout with ample clearance for later deterministic packing. No per-pose scaling or recentering from bounding box.
No background scenery, checkerboard pixels, ground shadows, text, labels, borders, numbers, UI, rings, muzzle flashes, projectiles, smoke, dust, blood or effects. Output only this single idle animation image.

Last pose flows into first; do not duplicate endpoint.
